contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Trier mint Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, possibly of 330-331, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust laureate draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription; CONSTAN[---]VS[--]AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: GLOR IA EXERC ITVS. In exergue: probably TRS .…
